points.label: Duration and work
points.left: The LORD addresses the psalmist’s Lord, promises rule, swears an unchanging oath, and names a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.
points.right: Hebrews contrasts priests made without an oath with Jesus’ sworn and permanent priesthood, then speaks of covenant, intercession, and one offering.

payload.posture: Read both passages while keeping each speaker, setting, action, and later argument in its own setting.

rightEvidence.title: Hebrews contrasts priests without an oath with Jesus’ lasting priesthood

payload.tension: The psalm’s short oath becomes part of an extended claim about permanence, covenant, intercession, and offering.
payload.title: The psalm’s oath and a permanent priesthood
